d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how, in a dramatic escalation for West African regional security, Algeria has deployed its military forces across the border into neighbouring Niger for the first time in over half a century—sparking a fierce diplomatic standoff with the European Union. Speaking through fierce condemnations from Niamey and Algiers, both capitals rejected Brussels' initial scrutiny as "arrogant and immature" interference, insisting that sovereign African nations require no European permission to conduct bilateral security arrangements.
